const typeTag = Object.prototype.toString;
function ownFields(input, visit) {
  for (const key in input) Object.hasOwn(input, key) && visit(input[key], key, input);
}
function arrayItems(input, visit) { input.forEach(visit); }
function copyChild(value, deep) { return deep ? duplicate(value, deep) : value; }
function duplicate(input, deep) {
  if (input) switch (typeTag.call(input)) {
    case '[object Object]': {
      const target = {};
      ownFields(input, (value, key) => target[key] = copyChild(value, deep));
      return target;
    }
    case '[object Array]': {
      const target = [];
      arrayItems(input, value => target.push(copyChild(value, deep)));
      return target;
    }
  }
  return input;
}
export const replicate = value => value && duplicate(value, true);
